title: Quick Actions in Zscaler Client Connector

blocks.text: You can quickly access a number of options from the Zscaler Client Connector app icon based on your OS.

blocks.item: Windows
You can right-click the app icon in the system tray to view a list of options.
Open Zscaler: Opens the Zscaler Client Connector app window.
Authenticate: Authenticate Zscaler Client Connector without opening the app.
Authenticate Early: Reauthenticate Private Access (ZPA) before your authentication expires.
Register: Click to complete the device enrollment.
Do Not Disturb: Pause pop-up notifications:
Mute for 30 minutes: Do not display pop-up notifications for 30 minutes.
Mute for 1 hour: Do not display pop-up notifications for 1 hour.
Mute for 2 hours: Do not display pop-up notifications for 2 hours.

Until Resumed: Do not display pop-up notifications until you select to resume them. When you select Until Resumed, this option displays as Notifications [Paused]. You must click Notifications [Paused] > Resume to turn the notifications back on.
Export Logs: Click to export logs. Logs are saved as a text file on your device.

Report an Issue: If your organization has enabled this option, you can click to report an issue. For instructions on completing the form, see Reporting an Issue with Zscaler Client Connector for Windows.
Exit: Click to exit the app and disable the Zscaler service. Depending on your organization's policies, you might be required to enter a password configured by your organization's admin.
Android
You can press and hold the icon to display a list of options:
Authenticate Early: Reauthenticate Private Access (ZPA) before your authentication expires.
Export Logs: Click to export logs. Logs are saved as a text file on your device.

Report an Issue: If your organization has enabled this option, you can click to report an issue. For instructions on completing the form, see Reporting an Issue with Zscaler Client Connector for Android.
Do Not Disturb: Pause pop-up notifications:
Disabled: Turn notifications off.
Enabled: Turn notifications on.
30 Minutes: Do not display pop-up notifications for 30 minutes.
1 Hour: Do not display pop-up notifications for 1 hour.
2 Hours: Do not display pop-up notifications for 2 hours.
Android on ChromeOS
You can press and hold the icon to display a list of options:
Authenticate Early: Reauthenticate Private Access before your authentication expires.
Export Logs: Export logs that are saved as a text file on your device.

Report an Issue: If your organization has enabled this option, you can report an issue to Zscaler. For instructions on completing the form, see Reporting an Issue with Zscaler Client Connector for Android.
Do Not Disturb: Pause pop-up notifications:
Disabled: Turn notifications off.
Enabled: Turn notifications on.
30 Minutes: Do not display pop-up notifications for 30 minutes.
1 Hour: Do not display pop-up notifications for 1 hour.
2 Hours: Do not display pop-up notifications for 2 hours.
